text:
maria.g: Hey everyone — Maria here, starting today. Trying to spin up the EU dev project but getting a 403 when creating a service account. Also my AWS cross-account role doesn't show up in the console. Who owns org billing / folder policies?

leo: welcome Maria! do you have the project ID?

maria.g: redwood-eu-dev-42

samir: curious — can you paste the exact error message? sounds like an IAM/org-policy block.

maria.g: error: "Permission denied: 'resourcemanager.projects.update' on project redwood-eu-dev-42. Contact project owner." plus a quick screenshot uploaded.

infra-bot: New project redwood-eu-dev-42 created by maria.g — pending IAM approvals.

leo: ack. this usually means a folder-level org policy restricting allowed regions and/or billing not linked. @cloud-oncall any ideas?

cloud-oncall: tagging infra — can you confirm whether the org has a RestrictResourceLocations policy for europe-*? if so we need to add this project to an allowed folder or relax the policy. also we can link billing if you give the billing account id.

samir: i can file a quick infra ticket. in the meantime you can try us-central1 if that helps for basic setup, but i know you mentioned data residency testing so that may not work.

maria.g: us-central won't do for compliance tests — EU required. what's the process/ETA to lift the block?

samir: filing infra ticket now: infra/9876 — request: allow europe-west* for project redwood-eu-dev-42. tagging org-admins. ETA usually ~1 business day but i'll escalate.

leo: also, for the AWS side — which cross-account role are you expecting? is it the org STS role or a team-specific role?

maria.g: the org-readonly role (redwood-org-dev-access) that used to show up under "Switch role" in AWS console. not seeing it in my account dropdown.

cloud-oncall: if it's missing, likely the role trust policy wasn't updated with your account id. @samir can you check the IAM role binding sync job?

samir: will check. quick workaround: we can add you to the dev org group so you inherit the role until we fix the role trust.

leo: FYI grant command for billing (if needed):

    gcloud beta billing accounts projects link \n      --billing-account=BIO-REDWOOD-EU \n      --project=redwood-eu-dev-42

samir: cloud-oncall — i updated the ticket with the billing id and region request and pinged org-admins. also kicked the IAM sync job for AWS roles.

cloud-oncall: update: i linked BIO-REDWOOD-EU to redwood-eu-dev-42 and asked org-admins to relax the folder policy for that project. monitoring.

maria.g: just retried and i can now create service accounts — SA created, keys generated, small test workload deployed. thank you! :raised_hands: 

infra-bot: infra/9876 status -> resolved by cloud-oncall (billing linked, folder policy adjusted).

leo: welcome aboard and glad that worked :tada: — if you hit anything else ping this thread or #eng-oncall.
